sqlTemplate:
SELECT DISTINCT s.patient_id
FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_summary s
WHERE s.baseline_regimen_start_date >= :startDate
  AND s.baseline_regimen_start_date < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
  AND s.baseline_cd4 REGEXP '^[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?$'
  AND CAST(s.baseline_cd4 AS DECIMAL(10,2)) < 200
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_encounter_diagnosis d
      WHERE d.patient_id = s.patient_id
        AND d.voided = 0
        AND d.diagnosis_coded IN (
            169721,
            169722,
            169723,
            169724,
            169725,
            169726,
            169727,
            169728,
            169729,
            169730,
            169731,
            169732,
            169733,
            169734,
            169735,
            169736,
            169737
        )
  )
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_medication_orders m
      WHERE m.patient_id = s.patient_id
        AND m.date_activated >= :startDate
        AND m.date_activated < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
        AND (
            LOWER(m.drug) LIKE '%voriconazole%'
            OR LOWER(m.drug) LIKE '%itraconazole%'
            OR LOWER(m.drug) LIKE '%amphotericin%'
        )
  );
